# A rocky headland: stacked faceted boulders 5 m long, 3 m deep, up to 2.6 m tall, a sand top and one
# palm. Placed twice (left, right) to frame the cove.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.3294 0.3059 0.4078 --no-slot
material new Sand --base-color 0.8157 0.5059 0.3490 --no-slot
material new Trunk --base-color 0.1255 0.2353 0.3373 --no-slot
material new Frond --base-color 0.0510 0.1686 0.2706 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name R0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.6 --location 0 0 1.0
scale 1.25 1.0 0.95
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 2
mode object
material assign Rock
add mesh ico-sphere --name R1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.2 --location -1.6 0.6 0.7
scale 1.25 1.0 0.95
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 3
mode object
material assign Rock
add mesh ico-sphere --name R2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.15 --location 1.5 -0.4 0.6
scale 1.25 1.0 0.95
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 4
mode object
material assign Rock
add mesh ico-sphere --name R3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.0 --location 0.4 1.2 0.5
scale 1.25 1.0 0.95
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 5
mode object
material assign Rock
add mesh ico-sphere --name R4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.9 --location -0.8 -1.0 0.4
scale 1.25 1.0 0.95
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 6
mode object
material assign Rock
add mesh ico-sphere --name R5 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.8 --location 2.4 0.6 0.3
scale 1.25 1.0 0.95
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 7
mode object
material assign Rock
add mesh ico-sphere --name Top --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.0 --location 0.1 0.2 2.25
scale 1.4 1.1 0.35
apply --scale
material assign Sand
add mesh cube --name HT0 --size 1 --location 0.384 0.300 2.683
scale 0.160 0.160 0.807
apply --scale
set rotation 0 12.407418527400745 0
apply --rotation
material assign Trunk
add mesh cube --name HT1 --size 1 --location 0.553 0.300 3.450
scale 0.140 0.140 0.807
apply --scale
set rotation 0 12.407418527400745 0
apply --rotation
material assign Trunk
add mesh cube --name HT2 --size 1 --location 0.722 0.300 4.217
scale 0.120 0.120 0.807
apply --scale
set rotation 0 12.407418527400745 0
apply --rotation
material assign Trunk
add mesh cube --name HF0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.1 0.32 0.07
apply --scale
set rotation 0 25 -1.1
apply --rotation
set location 1.306 0.290 4.420
apply --location
material assign Frond
add mesh cube --name HF1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.1 0.32 0.07
apply --scale
set rotation 0 25 68.2
apply --rotation
set location 0.992 0.764 4.420
apply --location
material assign Frond
add mesh cube --name HF2 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.1 0.32 0.07
apply --scale
set rotation 0 25 133.2
apply --rotation
set location 0.464 0.665 4.420
apply --location
material assign Frond
add mesh cube --name HF3 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.1 0.32 0.07
apply --scale
set rotation 0 25 227.0
apply --rotation
set location 0.465 -0.066 4.420
apply --location
material assign Frond
add mesh cube --name HF4 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.1 0.32 0.07
apply --scale
set rotation 0 25 273.2
apply --rotation
set location 0.834 -0.199 4.420
apply --location
material assign Frond
add mesh ico-sphere --name HC --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location 0.806 0.300 4.600
material assign Frond
select R0 R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 Top HT0 HT1 HT2 HF0 HF1 HF2 HF3 HF4 HC
active R0
join
rename R0 Headland
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < -0.1"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export headland.glb
